integrity: The scalar partition dimension is explicitly treated as prior work; the retained contribution is the complete minimum-partition classification and exact enumeration. The proof is self-contained and finite checks are not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for \(n\ge3\); smaller cocktail-party graphs are outside the claim.
\(B_n\) counts partitions with unordered blocks; ordered block lists are counted by \((n+1)!B_n\).
Exhaustive computation covers \(n=3,4,5\) only and is supplementary to the all-\(n\) proof.
The 2026 cocktail-party partition-dimension paper was available only at abstract/metadata level during the comparison, leaving a residual risk about unadvertised minimizer structure in its full text.
title: All partition bases of cocktail-party graphs
